content:
Yes. `pyenv virtualenv-delete <venv-name>` removes the entire virtualenv directory, so everything inside it is deleted too—including all packages installed in that venv (and their metadata, scripts, etc.).

It does **not** affect:
- the base Python version managed by `pyenv` that the venv was created from
- packages in other virtualenvs
- system Python packages (unless they were only present inside that venv)

If you want to double-check what will be removed, you can locate the venv first (typically under `~/.pyenv/versions/<venv-name>` or `~/.pyenv/versions/<python-version>/envs/<venv-name>` depending on how it was created).
